AD Data protection

Privacy Policy.

We clearly explain what data we process, why we use it and how you can exercise your rights.

Effective date: November 9, 2026Paraguay
On this page
ControllerData processedPurposesLegal basisProvidersRetentionRightsSecurityUpdates

1. Controller

ARANDU DEV E.A.S. UNIPERSONAL, tax ID 80180147-8, with its institutional base in Piribebuy, Cordillera, Paraguay, is responsible for the processing described in this policy.

Privacy contact: contacto@arandudev.com.

2. Data we process

When you use the contact form, we may receive your full name, email address, company or organization, optional phone number, project type and the message you send us.

Infrastructure and security providers may also process minimal technical logs, such as connection, browser, device, date, time and events needed to operate and protect the service.

3. How we use the data

  • Respond to inquiries and maintain project-related communications.
  • Assess needs and prepare proposals or pre-contract steps.
  • Protect the website, prevent abuse and resolve technical incidents.
  • Comply with legal and administrative obligations or defend rights.

We do not sell personal data or use it for third-party advertising.

4. Basis for processing

We process data when a person voluntarily provides it to request information, when it is needed for pre-contractual or contractual steps, when required by law, or when proportionate protection of the service’s security and operation is necessary.

Personal Data Protection Law No. 7593/2025 is currently being implemented. ARANDU DEV already applies its principles of transparency, purpose limitation, security and respect for individual rights.

5. Providers and transfers

We use technology services that act as infrastructure providers, including Cloudflare for website hosting, delivery and security, and Supabase for database and authentication services. These providers may process information on infrastructure outside Paraguay under their applicable terms and safeguards.

We share data only when necessary to provide the service, comply with a legal obligation or protect legitimate rights.

6. Retention

We retain information for as long as needed to respond to the inquiry, manage the requested relationship, maintain security and meet legal obligations. When no longer needed, it is reasonably deleted or anonymized.

7. Your rights

You may request information about how your data is processed and, where applicable, request access, correction, updating, objection or deletion. To do so, write to contacto@arandudev.com stating your request and the information needed to securely verify your identity.

We will respond within a reasonable period and in accordance with applicable law.

8. Security and minors

We apply reasonable technical and organizational measures to limit unauthorized access, alteration, loss or disclosure. No Internet-connected system can guarantee absolute security.

The website and its services are not specifically directed at minors. If a responsible adult believes a minor submitted data without authorization, they may request its deletion.

9. Updates

We may update this policy to reflect changes to the service, providers or applicable law. We will publish the current version and its date on this page.

For questions or to exercise your rights: contacto@arandudev.com.
